package.author: Bluebits BV
package.description: Drawing software for single-line diagrams and site plans of electrical installations

en-US.author: Bluebits BV
en-US.description: Drawing software for single-line diagrams and site plans of electrical installations
en-US.longDescription: With Trikker you can create a professional single-line schema and situation plan in no time. It is a complete and ready to use solution for electricians, in accordance with the latest obligations from the AREI.
en-US.name: Trikker
en-US.releaseNotes:
Trikker 1.5.104 is now available.
This update includes a targeted fix for the single-line diagram. In some cases, the name of a circuit was not perfectly aligned on the diagram. This was especially noticeable when printing and could make the final result look less clean.
With version 1.5.104, this issue has been corrected so that circuit labels are once again displayed properly, both on screen and on printed output.
Thank you for your trust and feedback. With every update, we continue to refine and improve Trikker step by step.
